limits: Source rasters are floor layouts, not measured CAD; scale is calibrated to the published apartment area.
Original 59/81 rigid placement preserved; other placements follow the numbered floor SVG and existing reconstructed tower.
This release presents 17 individually traced examples; 203 original 2D records remain accessible. 107 unique image hashes do not imply 107 distinct furnished 3D reconstructions.

The present 588 page references a new filename whose official endpoint returned HTTP 200 with an empty PNG body on 12.10.2026. The non-empty archived official plan remains unchanged and is retained with its 09.10.2026 snapshot date.
Window sill/head elevations and furnished interior dimensions are visual estimates; furniture fitout is authored.
Room count follows original published metadata, rather than an invented translation of bedroom count.
